tools.name: maskbolt_click
tools.description: Segment one object from points (on it; a third value 0, or 'exclude', marks points not on it) and/or a box [x0,y0,x1,y1], in image pixels. Picks SAM's best mask, or level smallest (a part), middle (the object), largest (the object with what it holds); the reply lists all three sizes so you can switch. Skips a mask that duplicates an existing one, lies inside one ('inside #n') or contains one ('contains #n') unless force is true. Returns the new id, what is still uncovered, and a zoomed preview. Use it for single cutouts and to add objects find missed.

Level.description:
Which of SAM's three nested masks to keep: the one with the best predicted IoU (default), or by size:
smallest (a part), middle (the object), largest (the object with what it sits in or holds).

box.description: Box around the object [x0, y0, x1, y1]; alone, its centre is used as the point.

exclude.description: Points that are not part of the object, [[x, y], ...].

fill_holes.description: Fill holes inside the new mask.

force.description: Keep the mask even if it duplicates or overlaps an existing one.

level.description: best (default: highest predicted IoU), smallest (a part), middle (the object), largest (with what it holds).

points.description: Points on the object, [[x, y], ...] in image pixels; a third value 0 marks a point NOT on the object.

tools.name: maskbolt_export
tools.description: Write masks to a file inside the root: overlay (numbered PNG; region zooms), cutout (transparent PNG of the chosen masks), svg (outer loops and holes, fill-rule evenodd; mm_per_px gives millimetres), json (outlines with holes, area, bbox, score per mask) or labels (PNG, one colour per mask). Default: all masks. Existing files are kept unless overwrite is true; the open image is never overwritten. Use it when the masks are right.

oneOf.description: PNG of the image with numbered, coloured masks.
Transparent PNG of the chosen masks, cropped to them.
SVG paths: outer loops and holes, fill-rule evenodd.
JSON: outlines with holes, area, bbox, score per mask.
PNG the size of the image, one colour per mask, transparent background.

format.description:
overlay (numbered PNG), cutout (transparent PNG), svg (outlines with holes), json (outlines, areas,
boxes, scores) or labels (PNG, one colour per mask).

mm_per_px.description: Millimetres per pixel, for svg and json in mm.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists (default false). The open image is never replaced.

path.description: Output file inside the root folder; missing folders are created.

region.description: overlay only: zoom on a region.

tools.name: maskbolt_fill_holes
tools.description: Fill holes inside masks (pixels the outside cannot reach without crossing the mask), e.g. a cup whose highlight was left out. Default: all masks. Do not use it where holes are real (rings, plates with cut-outs).

tools.name: maskbolt_find
tools.description: Find every object automatically with a grid of point prompts, over the whole image, a region, or overlapping tiles (tile: e.g. 400 px; each tile is re-encoded at full model resolution, so small or dense objects show up; masks cut by a tile edge are dropped, the overlap covers them). Duplicates and masks inside or containing existing ones are skipped. A tiled find does not run a whole-image pass: objects larger than about a third of a tile are dropped, so run a find without tile first for big objects. At most 64 tiles and a 48x48 grid per call (about 3 s per tile and 0.02 s per prompt on a 16-core CPU). Returns counts, why candidates were dropped, what still looks uncovered, and a numbered preview. Use it after open for 'all the objects' tasks; then view, remove wrong masks, click missed ones.

grid.description: Prompt points per side (default 16; 32 for dense scenes; per tile when tiling; at most 48).

max_area_frac.description: Largest mask as a fraction of the image area (default 0.25).

min_area_frac.description: Smallest mask as a fraction of the image area (default 0.0005).

region.description: Only look inside this region of the image (pixels).

tile.description:
Tile size in pixels (e.g. 400): overlapping crops, each re-encoded at full model resolution, so small
or dense objects show up. Slower: one encode per tile; at most 64 tiles per call.

tools.name: maskbolt_gaps
tools.description: Find more like these: list uncovered patches whose colour matches the masks found so far (at least 0.3x the median mask size), with one click point each, biggest first. With add: true, clicks them all and keeps masks of a plausible size (0.3 to 2.5x the median), in up to 2 rounds. Use it when find or your clicks left objects out.

add.description: Click every candidate point now and keep masks of a plausible size (default false: only list them).

rounds.description: With add: rounds of gap search and clicks (default 2).

tools.name: maskbolt_open
tools.description: Open an image and encode it with Segment Anything (about 7 s on CPU; the first call also downloads the model once and says its size). Clears all masks. Use this first, and again for each new image. Path must be inside the server's root folder.

path.description: Image file (PNG, JPEG or WebP) inside the root folder; relative paths are resolved against the root.

tools.name: maskbolt_remove
tools.description: Remove masks by id (wrong, merged or duplicate ones seen in view). Returns what was removed and what is still uncovered.

tools.name: maskbolt_view
tools.description: Show the image with every mask filled in its own colour, outlined, with its id at its centre, plus the list of masks (id, area, bbox, score, source). Pass region {x,y,w,h} to zoom (small regions are enlarged): use zooms to check small or dense objects before removing or clicking. Preview pixels map to image pixels as image_x = region.x + preview_x / scale (same for y).

max_side.description: Longest side of the returned PNG (default 1000, at most 1568).

region.description: Zoom on this region (pixels); small regions are enlarged.
